website_event_sale, website_event_track: 3199 -> 3197, and both units are file deletions rather than reformattings.

1651e66b54e removed addons/website_event_sale/data/event_data.xml and addons/website_event_track/data/event_data.xml, whose only content was a <function> writing to an event.type resolved by an xmlid upstream a0a61713783 retired in 2022. Both files were themselves non-canonical, so deleting them dropped this count by exactly two without any file being reformatted. Verified by running _pretty_xml.py --dry-run over both modules at 1651e66b54e^: both files listed.

Nothing in that commit touched the formatting of a surviving file. The rename pass behind it (68aad2090c3) lengthened name= values in three XML files under addons/website, addons/website_hr_recruitment and addons/website_project; all three were already non-canonical at the parent and the non-canonical file LIST is byte-identical across that commit, 195 files either side, so the pass flipped nothing.

Measured 3197 at dfcad1586e9 in a clean detached worktree at the CI scope this floor is graded at, --addons-path=odoo/addons,addons with only test_lint installed, per odoo/CLAUDE.md. Not measured in the workspace checkout, and not at full workspace scope, which grades a different tree.
